com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Set the standing monthly planning budget for one category and currency using an exact amount with up to two decimal places. Recorded spending remains unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview setting this workspace’s monthly fuel budget to USD 2500.00. Show the current budget and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_set_budget, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare creating or updating a category's standing monthly planning budget in an explicit ISO currency. Finite nonnegative values must fit the existing two-decimal budget model; no silent rounding. Requires settings permission and confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: set_budget
title: Set a monthly budget
